KIND: initial
PDDL domain and problem:
; Covered pan on a stove, two arms.  Author-correct PDDL: the lid is NOT part of the pan (it is a loose body).
(define (domain covered-pan)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions :equality)
  (:types arm part)
  (:constants L R - arm handle lid rim - part)
  (:predicates (free ?a - arm) (holding ?a - arm ?p - part) (on-stove) (lifted) (overhang) (lid-secured)
               (can-grasp ?a - arm ?p - part) (handle-side ?a - arm) (far-side ?a - arm) (part-of-pan ?p - part))
  (:action pick
    :parameters (?a - arm ?p - part)
    :precondition (and (free ?a) (on-stove) (can-grasp ?a ?p))
    :effect (and (holding ?a ?p) (not (free ?a))))
  (:action push
    :parameters (?a - arm)
    :precondition (and (holding ?a handle) (handle-side ?a) (on-stove) (not (overhang)))
    :effect (overhang))
  (:action clamp
    :parameters (?a - arm)
    :precondition (and (free ?a) (far-side ?a) (overhang) (on-stove))
    :effect (and (holding ?a rim) (lid-secured) (not (free ?a))))
  (:action lift-one
    :parameters (?a - arm ?p - part ?b - arm)
    :precondition (and (holding ?a ?p) (part-of-pan ?p) (on-stove) (free ?b) (not (= ?a ?b)))
    :effect (and (lifted) (not (on-stove))))
  (:action lift-two
    :parameters (?a1 - arm ?p1 - part ?a2 - arm ?p2 - part)
    :precondition (and (holding ?a1 ?p1) (holding ?a2 ?p2) (part-of-pan ?p1) (part-of-pan ?p2) (on-stove) (not (= ?a1 ?a2)))
    :effect (and (lifted) (not (on-stove)))))

(define (problem lift-covered-pan)
  (:domain covered-pan)
  (:init (free L) (free R) (on-stove)
         (can-grasp L handle) (can-grasp R handle) (can-grasp L lid) (can-grasp R lid)
         (handle-side L) (far-side R) (part-of-pan handle) (part-of-pan rim))
  (:goal (lifted)))


Scene geometry (world frame, metres; x forward, y left, z up):
stove block: top centre (0.380, -0.300), half size [0.12, 0.12, 0.03]
pan: centre [0.38, -0.3, 0.82], inner radius 0.09, wall height 0.04, wall 0.0025
handle: from [0.38, -0.208, 0.82] to [0.38, -0.078, 0.82], width 0.024, thickness 0.014
lid: centre [0.38, -0.3, 0.864], resting on the pan (not fixed), knob on top
left arm base n/a, right arm base n/a

Grasp specification: Each arm has a parallel two-finger claw: max opening 100 mm, fingers 80 mm long, squeeze up to 10 N. The left claw takes the handle from its end (approach along -y, fingers above and below the handle). The right claw can reach the far side of the pan (approach along +y) or the handle from the side or tilted.

Constraint API (Z3 expressions; And, Or, Not, Implies, If, AtMost, AtLeast are available; no imports):
  api.steps(): the action time steps 0..H-1
  api.action(name, *args, t): Bool: ground action (name args...) is taken at step t (False if no such ground action).
  api.actions(name=None, t=None): list of (name, args, t, Bool) for every ground action matching name (all if None) at step t (all if None).
        args are spelled as in the PDDL file (e.g. 'L', 'handle'); action()/holds() accept any case.
  api.holds(pred, *args, t): Bool: fact (pred args...) is true at time t (state BEFORE the action of step t).  Static facts are constants.
  api.disallow(name, *args, when=None): block the action at every step (optionally only when when(t) holds).
  api.add(*exprs): None

Example (a different domain: items in containers with lids):
Issues: 1. An item cannot be picked from or placed into a container whose lid is closed; the lid must be removed first.
```python
def constraints(api):
    for c in ("box1", "box2"):
        for o in ("cup", "spoon"):
            api.disallow("pick", o, c, when=lambda t, c=c: api.holds("closed", c, t=t))
            api.disallow("place", o, c, when=lambda t, c=c: api.holds("closed", c, t=t))
```

Task: lift the covered pan off the stove.
Step 1: list the issues that would make a task plan fail when refined into motions or executed (one line each).
Step 2: write ONE Python code block defining constraints(api) that encodes them. Reply with the issues and then the code block.
request.system: You are the reasoning module of a task and motion planner. You do not write plans. You read a PDDL domain and problem, look at the scene, and write task-level constraints that prevent task plans which cannot be refined into feasible robot motions or which would fail in the real scene.
